responsibility: This file implements a lexer-style input source with one-character pushback, file/line/column tracking, and location-aware diagnostics for the mc-boot runtime. It wraps an FIO input file, maintains a bounded pushback stack and current source filename, normalizes line counting while reading, allows strings or dynamic strings to be reinserted into the stream, and emits immediate or warning diagnostics annotated with the current file and line, making it the text-scanning support layer used by preprocessors and front-end utilities.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the stateful implementation of GPushBackInput: it owns the pushback stack, filename/line/column tracking, FIO-backed character acquisition, and diagnostic emission behavior, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/GPushBackInput.h only declares those services.
